attemptsReviewed: Commit 9d8223a (investigate: classify issue #55 as environment - memory banks exist but unpopulated) correctly identified this. Two prior investigation runs both reached the same conclusion: Hindsight memory banks are queryable but unpopulated. Commit 33ecf72 documented this environment classification. The repeated classification confirms the root cause.
rootCauseHypothesis: The project-neonpath Hindsight memory bank exists and returns valid responses, but no historical incident summaries have been ingested into it. The memory ingestion pipeline (which compacts first-seen/resolved/reopened incident back data with linked finding/run/commit/evidence IDs) has never run for project-neonpath. Without ingestion, recall returns only generic Factory operational notes stored in the default bank.
recommendedAction: Implement the Hindsight memory adapter for issue #55 first (bounded outbox, graceful offline handling, redaction, idempotency, bank isolation). Verify adapter correctness via unit tests. After passing verification tests, the memory ingestion pipeline can be run on demand as an operational task to backfill historical incidents. Do not treat bank population as a blocker to the adapter feature implementation.
